channel.title: The Hollywood Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter (hollywoodreporter.com)

item.title: Man Accused of Sending Fake Ransom Texts in Nancy Guthrie Case Appears in Court
item.description: Authorities say 42-year-old Derrick Callella allegedly tried to exploit the disappearance by sending phony bitcoin demands to her children.

item.title: Bath & Body Works Brings Back Fan-Favorite Disney Princess Collection With Fresh Fragrances
item.description: With select items already sold out within hours of launch, the 92-piece lineup spans body wash and cream, hand soap and sanitizer, fragrance mist, lip gloss, candles and accessories.

item.title: Santa Barbara Film Fest: Honoree Michael B. Jordan Says Chadwick Boseman “Was With Me” on ‘Sinners,’ ‘Creed 4’ “Definitely” Coming
item.description: The A-lister participated in a career-retrospective conversation and then collected the fest's Outstanding Performer of the Year Award from his costar and fellow first-time Oscar nominee Delroy Lindo.

item.title: Adam Sandler Says His Daughters Inherited His Love for Music: “They Jam in the House All Day Long”
item.description: The star, who received the ASCAP Founders Award in recognition of his musical accomplishments, also reminisced about his salad days of busking on subway platforms.

item.title: Casey Wasserman Will Sell Agency After Epstein Files Controversy: “I Have Become a Distraction”
item.description: The move comes after Wasserman faced mounting pressure from his roster after suggestive emails he sent to Ghislaine Maxwell surfaced in the Epstein Files

item.title: Basque Cinema Gets Its Goyas Moment
item.description: The region in northern Spain is reaping the rewards of its years-long production investment, heading into "the Spanish Oscars" with a record 45 nominations.

item.title: ‘The River Train’ Directors on Their Contemplative Argentinian Coming-of-Age Tale (Exclusive Berlin Trailer)
item.description: The feature debut of actor Lorenzo Ferro and Lucas A. Vignale, premiering in Berlin's Perspectives section, brings us a non-professional actor as its star, Malambo, and a trip into the big city and solitude.
